video.title: AI欧腐《镜头之外，爱意失控/MATCHPLAY : Love Action》
video.desc:
虽然有人发过了 但我弄这个弄了一天多了 还是发一下
Noah, a former global idol, lands a role in a Hollywood action film as his last chance to rebuild his shattered image. But on set, he runs into Cade, the stunt coordinator, who refuses to go easy on the arrogant Noah and pushes him hard at every turn. As the two clash over everything, a strange tension quietly begins to simmer between them. Meanwhile, it turns out that Jun — an old bandmate — was behind the rumored discord that drove Noah out of the group Signal. Watching Noah grow closer to Cade with growing irritation, Jun soon figures out Cade's true identity and begins to work at unraveling the two men's relationship…
前全球偶像Noah形象崩塌后，终于争取到一部好莱坞动作片的角色。这是他重建事业与名声的最后机会。
可刚进剧组，他就遇上了动作指导Cade。Cade完全不惯着傲慢的诺亚，处处严格要求他，把他逼到极限。两人从一开始就针锋相对，几乎事事都能吵起来，却也在一次次碰撞中，悄悄滋生出一种说不清的暧昧张力。
与此同时，真相逐渐浮出水面：当年让Noah被迫退出组合 Signal 的不和传闻，竟是旧队Jun在背后操纵。
看着Noah和Cade越走越近，Jun的嫉妒与不甘不断加深。很快，他查出了Cade隐藏的真实身份，并开始暗中出手，试图拆散两人的关系……
